scope: Offline Claude pending-MCP startup recovery, ToolSearch rejection compatibility, and condition tests; no model API, native CLI, or Docker calls.
next_step: Configure local CLI binaries, release and credentials, then run doctor and condition-specific smoke.
python_parse_scope: All Python files in the package

compatibility_fix.fixture_content: SDK call/error fields and source hashes only; identifiers and timing normalized.
compatibility_fix.accepted_short_error: Exact ToolSearch no-such-tool error with matching original native envelope, session, call ID, is_error, top-level proof and 0..30 second window.
compatibility_fix.isolation: ToolSearch and host tools remain disabled; exact registry and outbound tool checks retained.

mcp_startup_fix.accepted_state: First native init with exact session/model/workspace, empty tools, and one pending cowork MCP server; no tool activity, result, or prior isolation failure.
mcp_startup_fix.behavior: Fail and stop the current native attempt, then retry through the existing transport budget using the same native session, workspace, and original deadline.
mcp_startup_fix.isolation: Pending registry never passes validation; wrong identities, extra servers, early tools, native results, and repeated init remain terminal isolation failures.
mcp_startup_fix.session_reuse: A matching native init marks the existing session resumable, including first-start MCP delays.
